# GitHub Actions Status Badges

Add these badges to your main README.md to show build status:

```markdown
[![Build Status](https://github.com/wilddolphin2025/webrtcsays.ai/workflows/Build%20WebRTC/badge.svg)](https://github.com/wilddolphin2025/webrtcsays.ai/actions/workflows/build.yml)
[![PR Validation](https://github.com/wilddolphin2025/webrtcsays.ai/workflows/PR%20Validation/badge.svg)](https://github.com/wilddolphin2025/webrtcsays.ai/actions/workflows/pr-validation.yml)
[![Release Build](https://github.com/wilddolphin2025/webrtcsays.ai/workflows/Release%20Build/badge.svg)](https://github.com/wilddolphin2025/webrtcsays.ai/actions/workflows/release.yml)
```
